lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭਇਓ ਉਡਿ ਉਡਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer man pa(n)khee bhaio ud ud dah dis jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the mind has become a bird; it soars and flies in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੈਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੮੬॥
lines.transliteration: jo jaisee sa(n)gat milai so taiso phal khaai ||86||
lines.translation: According to the company it keeps, so are the fruits it eats. ||86||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੋਈ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaa kau khojate paaio soee thaur ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, you have found that place which you were seeking.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਤੂ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤਾ ਅਉਰੁ ॥੮੭॥
lines.transliteration: soee phir kai too bhaiaa jaa kau kahataa aur ||87||
lines.translation: You have become that which you thought was separate from yourself. ||87||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਰੀ ਮਰਉ ਕੁਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਕੇਲੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਬੇਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer maaree marau kusa(n)g kee kele nikat j ber ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I have been ruined and destroyed by bad company, like the banana plant near the thorn bush.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਹ ਝੂਲੈ ਉਹ ਚੀਰੀਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੇਰਿ ॥੮੮॥
lines.transliteration: uh jhoolai uh cheereeai saakat sa(n)g na her ||88||
lines.translation: The thorn bush waves in the wind, and pierces the banana plant; see this, and do not associate with the faithless cynics. ||88||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਭਾਰ ਪਰਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਚਰੈ ਚਲਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer bhaar paraaee sir charai chalio chaahai baat ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the mortal wants to walk on the path, carrying the load of others' sins on his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਡਰੈ ਆਗੈ ਅਉਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥੮੯॥
lines.transliteration: apane bhaarahi naa darai aagai aughat ghaat ||89||
lines.translation: He is not afraid of his own load of sins; the road ahead shall be difficult and treacherous. ||89||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਨ ਕੀ ਦਾਧੀ ਲਾਕਰੀ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰੈ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ban kee daadhee laakaree thaadhee karai pukaar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the forest is burning; the tree standing in it is crying out,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਬਸਿ ਪਰਉ ਲੁਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਜਾਰੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੯੦॥
lines.transliteration: mat bas parau luhaar ke jaarai doojee baar ||90||
lines.translation: "Do not let me fall into the hands of the blacksmith, who would burn me a second time." ||90||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਏਕ ਮਰੰਤੇ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਏ ਦੋਇ ਮਰੰਤਹ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ek mara(n)te dui mooe doi mara(n)tah chaar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, when one died, two were dead. When two died, four were dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਮਰੰਤਹ ਛਹ ਮੂਏ ਚਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੯੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaar mara(n)tah chhah mooe chaar purakh dui naar ||91||
lines.translation: When four died, six were dead, four males and two females. ||91||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂੰਢਿਆ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਉਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer dekh dekh jag dhoo(n)dhiaa kahoo(n) na paaiaa thaur ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I have seen and observed, and searched all over the world, but I have found no place of rest anywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅਉਰ ॥੯੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam na chetio kahaa bhulaane aur ||92||
lines.translation: Those who do not remember the Lord's Name - why do they delude themselves in other pursuits? ||92||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer sa(n)gat kareeai saadh kee a(n)t karai nirabaahu ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, associate with the Holy people, who will take you to Nirvaanaa in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਹੁ ॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: saakat sa(n)g na keejeeai jaa te hoi binaahu ||93||
lines.translation: Do not associate with the faithless cynics; they would bring you to ruin. ||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jag mahi chetio jaan kai jag mahi rahio samaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I contemplate the Lord in the world; I know that He is permeating the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਬਾਦਹਿ ਜਨਮੇਂ ਆਇ ॥੯੪॥
lines.transliteration: jin har kaa naam na chetio baadahi janame(n) aai ||94||
lines.translation: Those who do not contemplate the Name of the Lord - their birth into this world is useless. ||94||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅਵਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer aasaa kareeai raam kee avarai aas niraas ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, place your hopes in the Lord; other hopes lead to despair.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਮਾਨਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੯੫॥
lines.transliteration: narak parahi te maanaee jo har naam udaas ||95||
lines.translation: Those who dissociate themselves from the Lord's Name - when they fall into hell, then they will appreciate its value. ||95||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕੇਸੋ ਕੀਓ ਨ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer sikh saakhaa bahute keee keso keeo na meet ||
lines.translation: Kabeer has made many students and disciples, but he has not made God his friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਲੇ ਥੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਬੀਚੈ ਅਟਕਿਓ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: chaale the har milan kau beechai atakio cheet ||96||
lines.translation: He set out on a journey to meet the Lord, but his consciousness failed him half-way. ||96||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaaran bapuraa kiaa karai jau raam na karai sahaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what can the poor creature do, if the Lord does not give him assistance?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਡਾਲੀ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਉ ਸੋਈ ਮੁਰਿ ਮੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: jih jih daalee pag dharau soee mur mur jaai ||97||
lines.translation: Whatever branch he steps on breaks and collapses. ||97||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰਹ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਮੈ ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਰੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer avarah kau upadesate mukh mai par hai ret ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, those who only preach to others - sand falls into their mouths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਸਿ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਰਾਖਤੇ ਖਾਯਾ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੯੮॥
lines.transliteration: raas biraanee raakhate khaayaa ghar kaa khet ||98||
lines.translation: They keep their eyes on the property of others, while their own farm is being eaten up. ||98||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਉ ਕੀ ਭੂਸੀ ਖਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer saadhoo kee sa(n)gat rahau jau kee bhoosee khaau ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I will remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even if I have only coarse bread to eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਹੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: honahaar so hoihai saakat sa(n)g na jaau ||99||
lines.translation: Whatever will be, will be. I will not associate with the faithless cynics. ||99||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਦੂਨਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer sa(n)gat saadh kee din din doonaa het ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, in the Saadh Sangat, love for the Lord doubles day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਕਾਂਬਰੀ ਧੋਏ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੇਤੁ ॥੧੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kaaree kaa(n)baree dhoe hoi na set ||100||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic is like a black blanket, which does not become white by being washed. ||100||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੰਡਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਕੇਸ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer man moo(n)diaa nahee kes mu(n)daae kaa(n)i ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, you have not shaved your mind, so why do you shave your head?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮੂੰਡਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਅਜਾਂਇ ॥੧੦੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keeaa so man keeaa moo(n)daa moo(n)d ajaa(n)i ||101||
lines.translation: Whatever is done, is done by the mind; it is useless to shave your head. ||101||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer raam na chhodeeai tan dhan jaai ta jaau ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, do not abandon the Lord; your body and wealth shall go, so let them go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧੦੨॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal chit bedhiaa raamahi naam samaau ||102||
lines.translation: My consciousness is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||102||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਹਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਬਜਾਵਤੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਗਈਂ ਸਭ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jo ham ja(n)t bajaavate toot gaee(n) sabh taar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, all the strings of the instrument I played are broken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਚਲੇ ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੧੦੩॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)t bichaaraa kiaa karai chale bajaavanahaar ||103||
lines.translation: What can the poor instrument do, when the player has departed as well. ||103||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇ ਮੂੰਡਉ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer maai moo(n)dau tih guroo kee jaa te bharam na jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, shave the mother of that guru, who does not take away one's doubt.
